nodes.label: ATTRIBUTIONS.md
nodes.summary: Attribution notice for the Figma Make design app. Credits shadcn/ui components (MIT license) and Unsplash photos (Unsplash license) used in the bundle.

nodes.label: README.md
nodes.summary: README for the 'Design Front End UI/UX' code bundle exported from Figma. Documents that the project originates from a Figma design and gives run instructions: `npm i` to install and `npm run dev` to start the dev server.

nodes.label: default_shadcn_theme.css
nodes.summary: Default shadcn/ui design-token theme for the Figma design app. Declares CSS custom properties for light (`:root`) and dark (`.dark`) modes — background, foreground, primary/secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, chart, and sidebar colors (mix of hex and oklch) plus radius and font-weight tokens — then maps them to Tailwind theme variables via `@theme inline`. Marked KEEP_IN_SYNC with the shadcn globals.css source.

nodes.label: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite HTML entry document for the Figma design app. Sets charset/viewport/description meta, marks the page noindex/nofollow, applies full-height root styling, mounts a `#root` container, and loads the app via `<script type=module src=/src/main.tsx>`.

nodes.label: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest for the Figma design app ('@figma/my-make-file', private, type=module). Defines `dev` (vite) and `build` (vite build) scripts. Depends on React 18 (peer), the full Radix UI primitive set, MUI/Emotion, Tailwind 4 with @tailwindcss/vite, lucide-react, recharts, react-hook-form, react-router 7, motion, sonner, and other UI/utility libs. Dev deps: vite 6, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss. Includes a pnpm override pinning vite to 6.3.5.

nodes.label: pnpm-workspace.yaml
nodes.summary: pnpm workspace definition for the Figma design app, declaring a single package at the current directory ('.').
